newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Kimberly Clark buys Czech diaper maker.
newsitem.headline: Kimberly Clark buys Czech diaper maker.

text.p: U.S. personal care products group Kimberly Clark Corp said on Thursday it had purchased the largest Czech nappy maker Zisoft-Bobi a.s. for an undisclosed sum, pending regulatory approval in the Czech Republic.

"The transaction, which must still be approved by the Ministry for Economic Competition, was executed on October 1, 1996," Kimberly Clark said in a statement issued through its Czech public relations representative.
"Thanks to (the acquisition) Kimberly Clark has become the largest company in the field of personal care in the Czech Republic."
It said the purchase price would not be made public.
Zisoft-Bobi is a successful firm with large growth potential on domestic and foreign markets, it said.
"Kimberly-Clark is pleased that it can include Zisoft-Bobi and its employees into its group," the statement said.
